title: SO-F-06 Structured-state convergence contract for the engine: input and output schemas per merge class validated in the single boundary, forbidden states rejected, human-resolution items never auto-merged, and one doctor check when the engine is unavailable
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-F-06) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design record SO-2.01 (Organisational knowledge model: relationships between people, teams, projects, decisions, artefacts and evidence) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Builds on signed vault contracts: MEM-131†, WO-05-A†, WO-05-B†. Memev contracts that land first: SO-F-02, SO-1.01. Source in the fold: #222 section 13.7 (the engine does not decide whether work is correct, authorised or verified) and #223 PAID-CONVERGENCE.md (scope boundary; explicit schemas, authority rules and conformance tests). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) src/engine/paid-merge.mjs is in scope but does not exist and has no place: everything goes through the single boundary src/engine/merge.mjs (registerMergeProvider, resolveMerge). Dropped from scope. (4) crdt-merge is reached only through that provider boundary and no merge engine is added to the core (owner decision; the licence guard test/licence-core-guard.test.mjs from #326 stays in force). (5) Boundary with PG-05.1 WP05-04 and WP05-06 (state mapping and round trip): those map state; this contract validates the payload at the boundary. Neither restates the other. (6) Prerequisite SO-1.01 added: the forbidden-transition rule acts on the wired transition table.

tasks.description: The engine boundary of WO-05-A speaks notes through the single boundary src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md). Extending it to structured state means schemas per merge class derived from SO-F-02, validation in both directions inside that boundary, the SO-F-02 rule applied at the boundary (a returned state outside the transition table is rejected and recorded), human-resolution items kept as both versions with a blocker, and a doctor check when the engine is unavailable; the WO-05-B fallback itself is unchanged. No strategy names and no benchmark figures appear.

stop_rules: Stop and post BLOCKED when a criterion cannot pass without weakening a test, skipping a test or relaxing an assertion.
Stop and ask when the work would name a client product, a person, a server or a seat in repository text; the client names live in docs/CLIENTS.md only.
Stop when the work would add a runtime dependency, a model call, a network call at install or start, a second store for project state, or any reporting that is not opt-in and off by default.
Stop when the work would move convergence logic into the core, vendor the engine, or add a merge engine beside the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs.

Stop when the work would implement a federation, replication, trust, admission or computation feature beyond the specification, schema, validator and conformance test the contract names; the product keeps the planned label on it.
If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
